reading_note: The teaching traces the unfolding of Divine Love and Wisdom through five discrete degrees of emanation, from the inmost celestial source down to the form of light received by the regenerated soul at the laying-down of the body. The arc moves: (1) the Inmost Divine (Father of Greatness, the unmeasurable), from whom proceed three primary emanations — the Spirit/matrix of life, the Beloved of truths, and the calling Ambassador; (2) the Ambassador, who in turn sends the Pillar of ascent, Divine Truth as Splendor, and the Virgin of pure reception; (3) Divine Truth itself (Jesus the Radiance), who calls forth the Mind of Light, the Judge of souls, and the Youth who mediates between heaven and earth bearing the testimony "what I have seen with my Father, that you do"; (4) the Mind of Light as apostle in human form; (5) the Form of Light revealed at death, accompanied by three angels bearing prize, garment, and crown — given to the just who have lived in peace and mercy. The whole is a single revelation of how influx descends through degrees and how the regenerate ascend back through the same degrees clothed in light.
